preconditions.description: The length of the input string S must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABC' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The input string S must only contain the characters 'A', 'B', and 'C'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of substrings with equal numbers of 'A', 'B', and 'C'.
